theorem selected_surface_transport {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let s : ℝ := Real.sqrt κ
    let r : ℝ := (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) * ((s - 1) / (s + 1))
    let ℓ : ℝ := (4 * (n : ℝ) * s + (s - 1) ^ 2) /
      (8 * (n : ℝ) * ((n : ℝ) - 1))
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let c : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) :=
      fun O => WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) i j0)
    let ν : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) := (orthogonalHaar n).map c
    let τ : Measure (Metric.sphere (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) 1) :=
      (volume : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))).toSphere
    let σ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      (τ Set.univ)⁻¹ • τ.map (fun y => y.val)
    let f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun y =>
      ((s + 1) * WithLp.ofLp y j0 - (s - 1)) /
        (1 + r ^ 2 - 2 * r * WithLp.ofLp y j0) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    ν = σ ∧ IsProbabilityMeasure σ ∧ Integrable f σ ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
          (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) ∂γ O)
        ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
        (((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (s - 1) ^ (n - 1)) / (s + 1) ^ n) *
          (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ)) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * (∫ y, f y ∂σ)

definition_audit.s,r,ell,j0: Literal selected source parameters; all dimension arithmetic in divisions is real after coercion.

definition_audit.tau: Literal Mathlib (actual Euclidean volume).toSphere on the genuine metric unit sphere; its cone formula is tau(S)=n*volume({r*y | 0<r<1, y in S}), not a group-orbit law by definition.
definition_audit.sigma: Literal actual volume-derived surface measure normalized by its finite positive total mass, then pushed to ambient Euclidean space by subtype inclusion. definition_audit.f: Literal ambient totalized real quotient with real n/2 powers. Only actual sigma L1 is concluded; no global denominator positivity/continuity.
definition_audit.gamma: Unchanged actual canonical multivariateGaussian with inverse of the literal Eq4 singleBlockPrecision matrix.
definition_audit.orthogonalHaar: Unchanged characterized actual normalized full orthogonal Haar, both determinant components, not SO(n).

Surface normalization/invariance, any invariant-law uniqueness/transitivity and all measurability are proof dependencies, never new public premises.
